title: Why FastAPI
summary: Understand what makes FastAPI different from other Python web frameworks.

sections.content: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python. It is based on Starlette (an ASGI toolkit) and Pydantic (a data validation library). It uses Python type hints everywhere, which gives you editor autocompletion, fewer bugs, and automatic documentation for free.
Performance-wise, FastAPI is on par with Node.js and Go frameworks for typical API workloads. Most of your response time is determined by database calls anyway — FastAPI just doesn't get in the way.

rows: Editor autocompletion, fewer bugs, self-documenting code
Invalid data never reaches your logic — 422 responses are automatic
Swagger UI (/docs) and ReDoc (/redoc) out of the box
Very high concurrency on IO-bound work

sections.title: When to pick something else
sections.content: If you need server-rendered HTML as the main deliverable, use Django. For a tiny micro-service, Flask is fine too. For pure APIs, FastAPI is the default choice in modern Python.
FastAPI is built on two foundational libraries:

items: Starlette — the ASGI framework that handles HTTP routing, middleware, WebSocket support, and the event loop
Pydantic — the data validation library that powers request/response models, type coercion, and automatic JSON schema generation

sections.content: FastAPI combines these two and adds a thin layer of routing decorators, dependency injection, and auto-documentation on top. Understanding this stack helps you debug issues and extend the framework when needed.

quiz.question: What are FastAPI's two foundational libraries?
quiz.explanation: FastAPI is built on Starlette (ASGI framework) and Pydantic (data validation).

quiz.question: What does FastAPI generate automatically from your type hints?
quiz.explanation: FastAPI auto-generates Swagger UI and ReDoc documentation from your type annotations and route definitions.

quiz.question: What happens when a client sends invalid data to a FastAPI endpoint?
options: The app crashes with a 500 error
A 422 validation error is returned automatically
quiz.explanation: FastAPI validates incoming data against your Pydantic models and returns a 422 Unprocessable Entity with detailed error messages.

quiz.question: Which ASGI toolkit does FastAPI use under the hood?
quiz.explanation: Starlette is the ASGI toolkit that FastAPI uses. uvicorn is the ASGI server, and gunicorn is a WSGI/ASGI process manager.

quiz.question: When should you NOT choose FastAPI?
options: Server-rendered HTML as the main deliverable
quiz.explanation: For server-rendered HTML as the primary deliverable, Django is a better choice. FastAPI is optimized for APIs.
